axioms.name: Experimental.P03_08.laplace_density_hasDerivAt
axioms.meaning: For every natural k and positive tau,y, the displayed infinite exponential density has the displayed termwise tau derivative.
dependencies: Termwise parameter differentiation and convergence of the actual exponential series
